scope: Reviewer execution incident, not browser verification evidence
cause: Reviewer used an overly broad test glob while trying to add missing deterministic suites. This unintentionally included two self-executing legacy browser runners despite the assigned no-browser restriction.
outcome: Both browser launches failed with socket() failed: Operation not permitted. Processes exited before any browser interaction, check or screenshot. A stop was sent after noticing the broad expansion; the command had already finished. No retry or alternate browser route was used.
remediation: Only explicit deterministic test-file allowlists are used now. Preserve this log and do not claim browser QA. Parent was told that legacy default report files were overwritten; original frozen evidence remains separate.
processInspectionResult: Ordinary ps listing showed no Chromium, crashpad, browser runner or Node test process.
safeEntrypoint: scripts/record_validated_milestone.py expands only app/*.test.js plus tests/test_*.js. No browser runners are selected.
